stories.title: Hundreds of first responders gather in Spokane to honor fallen deputies Mason Acheson and Parker Perry
stories.summary: Beyond the ceremonial traditions, the service offered a glimpse into the lives of two men who were husbands, fathers, friends and members of their communities.

stories.title: Man sentenced for stabbing and killing a man in downtown Spokane
stories.summary: 21-year-old Colin Pedro will spend 20 years in prison for stabbing and killing a man who intervened in a fight between Pedro and his boyfriend in August 2025.

stories.title: Live Coverage: Procession, memorial service honoring Deputies Acheson & Perry
stories.summary: The memorial began at 3 p.m. following a procession from the Spokane County Fairgrounds.

stories.title: 'Foreseeable assault': Family of high schooler attacked by another student in 2024 suing Mead School District
stories.summary: The family claims Mt. Spokane High School staff knew about threats against the teen, but failed to stop a beating that left him with a traumatic brain injury.

stories.title: Trial set after man pleads innocent in fatal shooting
stories.summary: Shawn Webster, 21, entered the plea during an arraignment hearing Tuesday to a felony charge for the death of resident Jason Sparks in mid-July.

stories.title: Kootenai County median-home price hits $570K
stories.summary: According to the Coeur d'Alene Regional Realtors, the median price of a single-family home in Kootenai County in October rose 4.2% from a year ago.

stories.title: PF mayor unveils 20-year vision for a growing Post Falls in State of the City
stories.summary: Mayor Randy Westlund said the city is on track to double in population by 2045. That growth, he said, demands intentional choices now.

stories.title: Community holds candlelight vigil for fallen Deputies Acheson and Perry at Spokane's Law Enforcement Memorial monument
stories.summary: The co-chair of the Law Enforcement Officers Memorial Project says both names will be added to the monument by May.

stories.title: Grieving parents want ‘gas station heroin’ banned after teen’s death
stories.summary: A 17-year-old died after taking synthetic kratom. His parents want Edmonds to ban all kratom sales.

stories.title: Man charged in Queen Anne gas station homicide extradited to King County
stories.summary: Michael Anthony O'Neal Fleming was arrested in Chicago in October and has been charged with first-degree murder. He was booked into King County Jail Tuesday.

stories.title: Police get 2% market wage adjustment
stories.summary: A monthslong negotiation between the city of Coeur d’Alene and its police union has resulted in 2% market wage adjustment.

stories.title: North Idaho College celebrates new American Indian Student Center
stories.summary: A dream 30 years in the making has come true at North Idaho College.
